item.title: NXT rating for 02/18/2026
item.description: NXT last Wednesday drew 744,000 viewers, up big by 107,000 viewers over the previous week and their best number since July 22, 2025. The show, however, dropped in the 18-49 demo, getting only a 0.09 compared to the 0.12 of the prior episode, a drop of 0.03. (Ratings credit: Programming Insider) The post NXT rating for 02/18/2026 appeared first on Wrestling-Online.com.
